title_main: What do you want to watch?
ph_none: Nothing to type: just press Launch
hint_no_favorites: Type a channel, then “Add a favorite” to launch it here in one click.
hint_no_favorites_platform: No {platform} favorites yet: type a channel, then “Add a favorite”.
hint_no_recents: Your latest streams will show up here.
hint_favorites_panel: Click a row to fill the field. Right-click a card on the main screen for more options.
log_empty: Nothing yet. Streamlink’s output will appear here.
toast_no_scripts: No script in the selected folder
toast_fav_need_channel: Type a channel to add first
info_no_channel: {name} has no channel to add to favorites
err_empty: Paste a link or type a channel name
err_channel: Invalid {name} channel name (letters, digits, _ and - only)
err_youtube: No YouTube video ID found: paste the link or the ID (e.g. dQw4w9WgXcQ)
err_video: No {name} video ID found: paste the link or the ID
err_url: Invalid link: it must start with http:// or https://
hint_theme_auto: “Auto” follows Windows’ light or dark mode.
sl_missing_detail: Install it from streamlink.github.io or set its path
hint_show_scripts: Adds a “Scripts” pill to launch your old scripts.
confirm_quit_running: {count} stream(s) running. Stop them and quit?
log_player_not_found: {player} not found: default player used (set its path in Settings)
log_platforms_error: platforms.json could not be read ({error}): using default platforms
hint_live_check: Twitch and Kick favorites, while the launcher is open.
hint_live_previews: Thumbnail, title and viewer count of live Twitch favorites.
mini_hint: Tab: platform · ↓: suggestions · Enter: launch · Esc: close
toast_hotkey_taken: {key} is already taken by another application
toast_autostart_failed: Could not change the start-up setting
tray_hint_body: The launcher keeps running in the notification area. Right-click the icon to quit.
hint_tray: Closing the window keeps streams and live checks running.
hint_hotkey: Opens mini mode from any application.
hint_autostart: Starts minimized in the notification area.
hint_windows_only: These options only work on Windows.
hint_update_check: Compares your version with the latest published version of Streamlink and of the launcher.
toast_version_unknown: Could not read the Streamlink version
toast_update_page_opened: Download page opened in your browser
notif_update_body: Open the launcher’s Settings to update.
log_pip_command: To update, run in a terminal: {cmd}
hotkey_failed: {key} is already used by another application: pick another shortcut, then Save.
hotkey_unavailable: The global shortcut could not be initialized (see the log).
log_hotkey_failed: Global shortcut {key} refused by Windows (code {code}): already used by another application?
log_tray_failed: Could not initialize the notification area and global shortcut
data_restored: {file} was damaged: restored from its backup
data_unreadable: {file} could not be read: set aside as {saved}
log_data_folder: The launcher folder is read-only: data is saved in {path}
toast_drop_unknown: No link recognised in what was dropped
drop_sub: From a browser address bar, selected text or an Internet shortcut (.url)
mini_clip_hint: Copied link detected — Enter to launch, or type to replace it
hint_clipboard: Offers to launch a copied stream link when the window is activated, and pre-fills the mini bar
hint_backup: Saves your settings and favorites to a file, to restore them or copy them to another computer. Paths specific to this computer (Streamlink, player, scripts) are not included.
confirm_import:
Import {settings} setting(s) and {favorites} favorite(s)?

Yes: add the favorites to your current ones
No: replace your current favorites
Cancel: change nothing
confirm_import_settings: Import {settings} setting(s)? Your favorites will not change.
err_backup_read: This file could not be read
err_backup_invalid: This file contains no recognised settings or favorites
confirm_app_update:
Download and install version {latest}?
The launcher will restart.
toast_app_up_to_date: Streamlink Launcher is up to date
hint_auto_update: At start-up, downloads, verifies and installs the new version, then restarts the launcher. Needs “Check for updates at start-up” and the executable (.exe); never while a stream is running.
